scientific_integrity: A general three-move Ehrenfeucht–Fraisse lemma and explicit Hamming and Johnson adjacency-count identities furnish the uniform proof. The accompanying executable independently tests 116 small graphs but finite tests are not an infinite proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification and Johnson comparisons apply only to first-order quantifier rank at most three in the pure simple-graph language. Minimality of 27 holds only among Hamming graphs. The result does not solve an all-rank limit theory or establish historical priority against every earlier general graph-theoretic lemma.
source_ids: University of Leeds thesis 2022 (B. G. Benediktsson)
title: Exact rank-three theories of finite Hamming graphs and their Johnson coincidences
